literature.headline_zh: 发热伴血小板减少综合征研究新进展:治疗靶点、传播风险与预后预测。
literature.lead_zh: 本周研究揭示了SFTSV感染中全反式视黄酸的抗炎机制、非流行区家庭与院内传播风险、mNGS在合并感染诊断中的价值,以及多项死亡风险预测模型,为临床管理提供了新依据。
key_findings_zh: 全反式视黄酸通过RXRα-PPARγ异源二聚体抑制AP-1转录活性,减轻SFTSV诱导的小鼠全身炎症[10.1038/s41564-026-02411-6]。
上海非流行区发生SFTSV家庭及院内传播聚集性疫情,7例确诊含2例死亡及2例医护人员感染[10.1016/j.ijid.2026.108995]。
mNGS快速鉴定SFTSV合并侵袭性肺曲霉病及多重细菌感染,指导靶向治疗并改善预后[10.3389/fmed.2026.1888410]。
昏迷(OR=55.07)、多器官功能障碍综合征(OR=19.77)及弥散性血管内凝血(OR=12.02)是SFTS死亡最强预测因素[10.3390/pathogens15070767]。
入院时年龄、病毒载量及尿素水平构建的列线图可准确预测SFTS患者28天死亡风险(AUC=0.900)[10.1007/s11596-026-00228-2]。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: SFTSV在非流行区出现家庭及院内传播,提示需加强临床警觉与感染控制;重症患者合并真菌感染风险高,mNGS有助于早期诊断。
literature.caveats_zh: ATRA研究基于小鼠模型,临床转化需验证;聚集性疫情样本量小;mNGS病例报告不能单独归因于诊断技术;荟萃分析存在异质性。
literature.headline_en: New Advances in SFTS: Therapeutic Targets, Transmission Risks, and Prognostic Predictors.
literature.lead_en: This week's studies reveal the anti-inflammatory mechanism of all-trans retinoic acid in SFTSV infection, family and nosocomial transmission in a non-endemic area, the diagnostic value of mNGS in co-infections, and multiple mortality prediction models, providing new evidence for clinical management.
key_findings_en: All-trans retinoic acid suppresses SFTSV-induced hyperinflammation in mice by forming RXRα-PPARγ heterodimers that inhibit AP-1 transcriptional activity [10.1038/s41564-026-02411-6].
A family and healthcare-associated SFTSV cluster in Shanghai, a non-endemic area, resulted in 7 cases including 2 deaths and 2 healthcare worker infections [10.1016/j.ijid.2026.108995].
mNGS rapidly identified SFTSV co-infected with invasive pulmonary aspergillosis and multiple bacteria, enabling targeted therapy and favorable outcome [10.3389/fmed.2026.1888410].
Coma (OR=55.07), MODS (OR=19.77), and DIC (OR=12.02) are the strongest predictors of SFTS mortality [10.3390/pathogens15070767].
A nomogram based on age, viral load, and urea at admission predicts 28-day mortality in SFTS patients with AUC 0.900 [10.1007/s11596-026-00228-2].
literature.trend_or_risk_en: SFTSV transmission in non-endemic areas via family and healthcare settings underscores the need for clinical vigilance and infection control; severe patients are at high risk of fungal co-infection, and mNGS aids early diagnosis.
literature.caveats_en: ATRA findings are from a mouse model and require clinical validation; the cluster study has a small sample size; the mNGS case report cannot attribute outcome solely to the diagnostic method; meta-analyses show heterogeneity.
literature.brief_en: This week's SFTSV research highlights ATRA as a potential therapeutic, reports a family-hospital cluster in Shanghai, validates mNGS for co-infection diagnosis, and identifies strong mortality predictors including coma, MODS, DIC, and a nomogram based on age, viral load, and urea.

papers.title: All-trans retinoic acid suppresses systemic inflammation induced by severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus in mice.
papers.abstract: The vitamin A metabolite all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) has immunoregulatory features, but its systemic role during viral infection is unclear. Here we show that patients infected with severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV), an emerging tick-borne infection, have depleted serum vitamin A and ATRA levels. This correlated with exacerbated systemic inflammatory response syndrome severity and mortality risk. In an SFTSV mouse model, intraperitoneal administration of ATRA suppresses virus-induced hyperinflammation via peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-γ (PPARγ), which downregulates the transcriptional activity of activator protein-1 (AP-1 in macrophages. Mechanistically, ATRA binds retinoid X receptor-α (RXRα) and facilitates the formation of RXRα-PPARγ heterodimers. This complex sequesters the transcription factor JUN and suppresses the expression of AP-1 promoter-dependent genes, such as IL-6, thus attenuating inflammatory signalling pathways. Our study suggests a retinoid-mediated immunometabolic checkpoint during SFTSV infection and proposes retinoid signalling as a therapeutic target for cytokine storm management.

papers.title: Predictive Value of Admission Renal Injury-Related Indicators for Fatal Outcomes in Patients with Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging infectious disease with high mortality rates. While previous studies have focused primarily on the epidemiological and clinical aspects of SFTS, indicators of renal injury at admission have received limited attention. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 260 patients with SFTS admitted to the study hospital between April 1, 2023, and July 18, 2024, who were classified into the survival group (n = 163) and death group (n = 97) on the basis of 28-day prognosis. Renal-related data were collected upon admission. Univariate and multivariate Cox regression analyses were used to identify independent predictors, and a nomogram was constructed. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves and calibration curves were used to assess the discrimination and calibration of the model. Kaplan-Meier curves were used to assess the cumulative survival rate of patients with these risk factors. External validation was conducted in 40 patients with SFTS who were admitted to an affiliated branch hospital during the same period. RESULTS: The 28-day mortality rate was 37.3% (97/260). Multivariate analysis revealed age (HR = 1.053; 95% CI 1.027-1.079; P < 0.001), viral load (HR = 2.006; 95% CI 1.684-2.390; P < 0.001), and UREA (HR = 1.059; 95% CI 1.027-1.093; P < 0.001) as independent risk factors. The area under the curve (AUC) of the nomogram was 0.900 (95% CI 0.861-0.937), with 82.5% sensitivity and 84.0% specificity at the optimal cutoff (0.292). The calibration curve showed close agreement between the predicted and observed probability lines, indicating good model calibration. External validation yielded an AUC of 0.863 (95% CI 0.723-0.954), confirming favorable performance. CONCLUSION: Renal injury-related indicators at admission were strongly associated with fatal outcomes in patients with SFTS. Nomograms based on age, viral load, and UREA provide accurate and easily applicable tools for early risk stratification and may support individualized clinical management.

papers.title: Clinical Predictors of Mortality in Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick-borne disease with a high case fatality rate and no specific treatment. Identifying robust clinical predictors of mortality is crucial for improving patient outcomes. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to comprehensively evaluate the association of underlying diseases, hemorrhagic symptoms, neurological signs, and complications with fatal outcomes in SFTS patients. We systematically searched PubMed, Web of Science, CNKI, and Wan Fang databases up to 1 March 2026 for observational studies. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using fixed- or random-effects models. Forty-five studies, encompassing 8078 patients (1729 deaths), were included. Underlying diabetes (OR = 1.77) and hypertension (OR = 2.38) were significant risk factors. Among hemorrhagic symptoms, systemic manifestations (OR = 4.19), melena (OR = 4.26), and petechiae (OR = 3.20) were strong predictors. Neurological symptoms, particularly coma (OR = 55.07), were the most powerful predictors of death. Complications like multiple organ dysfunction syndrome (MODS, OR = 19.77) and disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC, OR = 12.02) also significantly increased mortality risk. The findings confirm that a range of clinical features, from underlying conditions to severe neurological and organ complications, are strongly associated with SFTS mortality. These predictors can guide clinicians in early risk stratification and intensive monitoring, especially in high-risk patients, to potentially reduce the high case-fatality rate.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注 发热伴血小板减少综合征病毒 (SFTSV),特别检查 死亡率 疾病患者中 死亡率 的临床预测因子。核心问题是确定哪些临床特征与 SFTSV 感染的致命结果最密切相关。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对截至2026年3月1日的PubMed、Web of Science、CNKI和万方数据库进行了系统检索,以进行观察性研究。它包括 45 项研究,共有 8078 名患者(1729 人死亡)。使用固定效应或随机效应模型计算具有 95% 置信区间 (CI) 的合并比值比 (OR),以评估临床预测因子与 死亡率 之间的关联。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查发现,基础糖尿病(OR = 1.77)和高血压(OR = 2.38)是SFTSV患者出现死亡率的重要危险因素。出血症状,如全身表现(OR = 4.19)、黑便(OR = 4.26)和瘀点(OR = 3.20)是强有力的预测因子。神经系统症状,特别是昏迷(OR = 55.07),是死亡最有力的预测因素。多器官功能障碍综合征(MODS,OR = 19.77)和弥散性血管内凝血(DIC,OR = 12.02)等并发症也显着增加 死亡率 风险。这些发现证实,从基础疾病到严重的神经和器官并发症的一系列临床特征与 SFTSV 死亡率 密切相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了研究中的异质性,所报告的临床预测因子与 死亡率 之间的关联存在一些不一致。此外,缺乏针对特定亚群或地理区域的研究,这可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。这些证据也没有解决这些关联背后的生物学机制,在理解上留下了一些空白。

papers.title: Cytokine Indicators Associated with Disease Severity in Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Objective: The purpose of this study is to study cytokine indicators for the identification of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) severity. Methods: We searched the literature in PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science published before 7 April 2026. The main results are presented as forest plots. Subgroup analyses, sensitivity analyses, and publication bias were also performed. Results: A total of 22 articles were eventually included in our study. Our findings demonstrate that circulating concentrations of Interleukin-6 (IL-6) (SMD = 2.02, 95% CI: 1.53–2.51, I2 = 95.2%), Interleukin-10 (IL-10) (SMD = 1.18, 95% CI: 0.92–1.44, I2 = 71.3%), Interleukin-8 (IL-8) (SMD = 0.91, 95% CI: 0.61–1.20, I2 = 69%), Tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) (SMD = 0.70, 95% CI: 0.43–0.96, I2 = 64.6%), Interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) (SMD = 1.32, 95% CI: 0.69–1.95, I2 = 89.1%), Interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β) (SMD = 1.78, 95% CI: 0.85–2.71, I2 = 94.8%), Monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1) (SMD = 1.15, 95% CI: 0.80–1.50, I2 = 46.1%), Interferon-alpha (IFN-α) (SMD = 1.53, 95% CI: 0.38–2.68, I2 = 89.6%), Granulocyte Colony-Stimulating Factor (G-CSF) (SMD = 1.79, 95% CI: 0.99–2.59, I2 = 68.1%) and Inducible protein 10 (IP-10) (SMD = 1.11, 95% CI: 0.60–1.62, I2 = 58.3%) are significantly elevated in patients with severe SFTS compared with those with mild disease, whereas Transforming Growth Factor-beta (TGF-β) (SMD = −0.51, 95% CI: −0.78–−0.24, I2 = 6.0%) and RANTES (SMD = −0.10, 95% CI: −0.40–0.20, I2 = 0.0%) levels are reduced in the severe group. Conclusions: By analyzing the cytokine indicators of SFTS patients, we have found some indicators that are representative of SFTS severity. Our findings provide a clinically actionable basis for early severity prediction and further useful evidence for clinicians to manage severe patients efficiently.

papers.title: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome complicated by invasive pulmonary aspergillosis and septic shock: a case report highlighting the role of mNGS
papers.abstract: Background Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick-borne viral hemorrhagic fever associated with high mortality, and no specific antiviral therapy is currently available. Patients with SFTS often develop immune dysfunction, rendering them susceptible to secondary opportunistic infections, particularly invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA). Early diagnosis of this co-infection is critical but remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and radiological findings. Case presentation A 61-year-old male farmer from a hilly region presented in July 2024 with fever, dyspnea, and altered consciousness. On admission, he exhibited septic shock and multiple-organ dysfunction, including severe thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, liver injury, and acute kidney injury. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) of blood and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid rapidly identified SFTS virus, Aspergillus fumigatus , Aspergillus flavus, and multiple Gram-negative bacteria. Chest imaging revealed bilateral nodules distributed along the bronchovascular bundles, suggestive of angioinvasive IPA. Treatment consisted of imipenem/cilastatin, isavuconazonium sulfate, continuous renal replacement therapy, and mechanical ventilation. The patient gradually improved and was discharged after 30 days, with complete clinical recovery documented at the 3-month and 9-month follow-up visits. Conclusion This case highlights the diagnostic value of mNGS in critically ill patients with SFTS and suspected co-infections, as it enables early pathogen identification and targeted therapy. Clinicians in endemic areas should maintain a high index of suspicion for SFTS and IPA in patients presenting with unexplained fever, thrombocytopenia, and organ dysfunction. However, the favorable outcome cannot be attributed solely to mNGS, as multiple supportive interventions were administered concurrently; the clinical improvement likely reflects a synergistic effect of timely targeted therapy and comprehensive intensive care.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一名来自山区的 61 岁男性农民于 2024 年 7 月就诊,出现发烧、呼吸困难和意识改变。入院时,他表现出感染性休克和多器官功能障碍,包括严重的血小板减少、白细胞减少、肝损伤和急性肾损伤。
elements_zh.methods: 血液和支气管肺泡灌洗液的宏基因组下一代测序 (mNGS) 快速鉴定出 发热伴血小板减少综合征 病毒、烟曲霉、黄曲霉和多种革兰氏阴性菌。胸部影像显示双侧结节沿支气管血管束分布,提示血管侵袭性 IPA。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 流行地区的临床医生应对出现不明原因发热、血小板减少和器官功能障碍的患者保持对 发热伴血小板减少综合征 和 IPA 的高度怀疑。这种合并感染的早期 诊断 至关重要,但由于非特异性临床表现和放射学检查结果,仍然具有挑战性。

papers.title: A Family and Healthcare-Associated Cluster of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome in Shanghai, China: An Epidemiological Investigation in a Non-Endemic Area.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe the epidemiological and clinical characteristics of a cluster of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) cases in Shanghai and assess the potential risk of healthcare-associated transmission. METHODS: Epidemiological and clinical data were collected from seven patients, including the index case, four family members, and two healthcare workers. Serum samples from five patients were tested for SFTS virus (SFTSV) RNA and SFTSV-specific IgM antibodies. RESULTS: The index case developed symptoms on June 12, 2018, and died on June 23. Between June 30 and July 6, three family members and one healthcare worker developed fever, thrombocytopenia, and leukopenia; SFTSV RNA was detected in their blood samples. One family member died of multiple organ failure 11 days after symptom onset. Another family member and one doctor developed febrile symptoms and were positive for SFTSV IgM antibodies. Overall, seven cases were identified, including two deaths and two infections among healthcare workers. CONCLUSIONS: This cluster suggests possible family and healthcare-associated transmission of SFTSV in Shanghai, a non-endemic area of China. Improved clinical awareness and infection prevention are needed when managing unexplained febrile hemorrhagic illnesses.

Lacking licensed vaccines or drugs, CCHFV is a World Health Organization priority pathogen requiring urgent development of medical countermeasures1,2. The CCHFV Large (L) protein functions as the viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase CCHFV-L, representing a promising antiviral target, and is among the largest viral polymerases in the order Bunyavirales. Here we define the cofactors required for CCHFV-L RNA synthesis in vitro, enabling capture and determination of elongating CCHFV-L–RNA complex structures. The structures show a markedly enlarged polymerase architecture, revealing that CCHFV-L RNA synthesis is accompanied by ordering of the polymerase peripheral domains. We also define how the baloxavir-derived experimental drug WXSH0208 (ref. 3) and the nucleoside analogue 2′-deoxy-2′-fluorocytidine4,5, which has nanomolar cellular potency, inhibit this polymerase through endonuclease inhibition and post-translocation chain termination, respectively. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the urgent need for medical countermeasures against Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV), a World Health Organization priority pathogen with no licensed vaccines or drugs, by investigating the structure and inhibition of its viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (CCHFV-L).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on the CCHFV Large (L) protein, which functions as the viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase, and was conducted in vitro to define the cofactors required for CCHFV-L RNA synthesis and to capture elongating CCHFV-L–RNA complex structures.
analysis.methods: The researchers defined the cofactors required for CCHFV-L RNA synthesis in vitro, enabling the capture and determination of elongating CCHFV-L–RNA complex structures, and analyzed how the experimental drug WXSH0208 and the nucleoside analogue 2′-deoxy-2′-fluorocytidine inhibit the polymerase.
analysis.main_results: The structures revealed a markedly enlarged polymerase architecture, with CCHFV-L RNA synthesis accompanied by ordering of the polymerase peripheral domains; WXSH0208 inhibited the polymerase through endonuclease inhibition, while 2′-deoxy-2′-fluorocytidine inhibited it through post-translocation chain termination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as providing structural guidance for the rational optimization of inhibitors directed against CCHFV-L, highlighting the novelty of the enlarged polymerase architecture and the specific mechanisms of inhibition by the two compounds.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of targeted antiviral therapies against CCHFV, a severe and often fatal tick-borne virus, by providing structural insights into its polymerase and the mechanisms of inhibition by experimental drugs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in vitro, which may limit the generalizability of the findings to in vivo conditions; however, the evidence strength is high due to the detailed structural and mechanistic analyses provided.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV) RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (CCHFV-L), a key antiviral target. The researchers defined the cofactors required for CCHFV-L RNA synthesis in vitro and captured elongating CCHFV-L–RNA complex structures, revealing a markedly enlarged polymerase architecture with ordered peripheral domains during RNA synthesis. They also determined that the experimental drug WXSH0208 inhibits the polymerase through endonuclease inhibition, while the nucleoside analogue 2′-deoxy-2′-fluorocytidine inhibits it through post-translocation chain termination. These findings provide structural guidance for the rational optimization of inhibitors against CCHFV-L, addressing the urgent need for medical countermeasures against this World Health Organization priority pathogen.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注 CCHFV 大 (L) 蛋白,该蛋白充当病毒 RNA 依赖性 RNA 聚合酶,并在体外进行,以确定 CCHFV-L RNA 合成所需的辅因子,并捕获延长的 CCHFV-L-RNA 复合物结构。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员定义了体外 CCHFV-L RNA 合成所需的辅因子,从而能够捕获和测定延长的 CCHFV-L-RNA 复合物结构,并分析了实验药物 WXSH0208 和核苷类似物 2′-脱氧-2′-氟胞苷如何抑制聚合酶。
elements_zh.main_results: 这些结构揭示了明显扩大的聚合酶结构,CCHFV-L RNA 合成伴随着聚合酶外围结构域的排序;WXSH0208 通过核酸内切酶抑制来抑制聚合酶,而 2'-脱氧-2'-氟胞苷则通过易位后链终止来抑制聚合酶。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为为针对 CCHFV-L 的抑制剂的合理优化提供了结构指导,强调了扩大的聚合酶结构的新颖性以及两种化合物的具体抑制机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过提供对其聚合酶的结构见解和实验药物的抑制机制,为针对 CCHFV(一种严重且通常致命的 蜱媒 病毒)的靶向 抗病毒药物 疗法的开发提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在体外进行的,这可能会限制研究结果在体内条件下的普遍适用性;然而,由于提供了详细的结构和机械分析,证据强度很高。

papers.title: Pharmacokinetics of injectable favipiravir: phase I, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study in healthy East Asian subjects.
papers.abstract: Favipiravir, an oral antiviral medication, has been approved in Japan for the treatment of patients with novel or re-emerging influenza and severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS). Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials were conducted in an East Asian population to characterize the pharmacokinetics and tolerability of an injectable favipiravir formulation. In the single-ascending dose trial, subjects received a single intravenous (IV) dose of 300-2,400 mg of favipiravir. In the multiple dose trial, 1,800 mg was administered twice daily on the first day, followed by 800 mg twice daily for the subsequent 10 days, which is the approved tablet dose for SFTS in Japan. This multiple-dose trial was divided into a cohort receiving intravenous administration throughout the treatment period (IV cohort) and a cohort switching to oral administration from Day 6 (Switching cohort). After a single administration of ≤2,400 mg, the pharmacokinetic parameters increased in a dose-dependent manner but showed slight deviation from linearity. The geometric mean maximum plasma concentration following a single 2,400 mg dose was 126 (range: 110 to 138) μg/mL. In the IV cohort, the trough (at 12 h post-dose) plasma concentrations were maintained at approximately 85 μg/mL after Day 2. These concentrations were approximately 20% higher than those achieved with the same oral doses. In the Switching cohort, these concentrations were maintained throughout the treatment. No serious adverse events were observed. These findings support advancing injectable favipiravir into clinical evaluation.CLINICAL TRIALSThis study is registered with the Japan Registry of Clinical Trials as jRCT2071210042 and jRCT2071210126.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 法匹拉韦是一种口服 抗病毒药物,在日本获批用于治疗新型或复发性流感和伴有血小板减少综合征的严重发烧(发热伴血小板减少综合征)。该研究旨在表征法匹拉韦注射制剂在东亚人群中的药代动力学和耐受性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在东亚人群中进行了随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。该研究包括单剂量递增试验和多剂量试验,后者分为静脉注射(IV)队列研究和队列研究从第6天开始转为口服给药。
elements_zh.methods: 在单次剂量递增试验中,受试者接受单次静脉注射剂量为 300 至 2,400 毫克的法匹拉韦。多剂量试验第一天服用 1,800 毫克,每天两次,随后服用 800 毫克,每天两次,持续 10 天,与日本批准的 发热伴血小板减少综合征 片剂剂量相匹配。
elements_zh.main_results: 单次给药≤2,400 mg后,药代动力学参数以剂量依赖性方式增加,但与线性略有偏差,2,400 mg剂量的几何平均最大血浆浓度为126 μg/mL。在IV 队列研究中,第2天后血浆谷浓度维持在约85 μg/mL,比口服剂量高约20%,并且没有观察到严重不良事件。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为支持注射用法匹拉韦进入临床评估的进展。研究表明,注射制剂的血浆浓度比同等口服片剂剂量高约 20%。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持注射用法匹拉韦的临床评估,可能为无法口服药物的患者提供治疗 发热伴血小板减少综合征 和流感的替代给药途径。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告具体的设计限制、样本量限制或详细的统计置信度评估。根据随机、双盲、安慰剂对照设计以及不存在严重不良事件,证据强度被评估为中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 法匹拉韦是一种口服 抗病毒药物,在日本获批用于治疗新型或复发性流感和伴有血小板减少综合征的严重发烧(发热伴血小板减少综合征)。该研究旨在表征法匹拉韦注射制剂在东亚人群中的药代动力学和耐受性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在东亚人群中进行了随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。该研究包括单剂量递增试验和多剂量试验,后者分为静脉注射(IV)队列研究和队列研究从第6天开始转为口服给药。
analysis_zh.methods: 在单次剂量递增试验中,受试者接受单次静脉注射剂量为 300 至 2,400 毫克的法匹拉韦。多剂量试验第一天服用 1,800 毫克,每天两次,随后服用 800 毫克,每天两次,持续 10 天,与日本批准的 发热伴血小板减少综合征 片剂剂量相匹配。
analysis_zh.main_results: 单次给药≤2,400 mg后,药代动力学参数以剂量依赖性方式增加,但与线性略有偏差,2,400 mg剂量的几何平均最大血浆浓度为126 μg/mL。在IV 队列研究中,第2天后血浆谷浓度维持在约85 μg/mL,比口服剂量高约20%,并且没有观察到严重不良事件。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为支持注射用法匹拉韦进入临床评估的进展。研究表明,注射制剂的血浆浓度比同等口服片剂剂量高约 20%。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持注射用法匹拉韦的临床评估,可能为无法口服药物的患者提供治疗 发热伴血小板减少综合征 和流感的替代给药途径。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告具体的设计限制、样本量限制或详细的统计置信度评估。根据随机、双盲、安慰剂对照设计以及不存在严重不良事件,证据强度被评估为中等。
